C-TRAININGS-LOGGER-COMMAND.Summary: Rename cmd/cli and the release executable to trainings-logger; exclude README files from binary release archives while retaining LICENSE.

Goals.Goal: Move all command files into cmd/trainings-logger and build binaries named trainings-logger (trainings-logger.exe on Windows).
Configure release archives with an explicit LICENSE-only extra-file list, overriding the default README inclusion.

Constraints.Constraint: Preserve application behavior, the build-time app-key linker symbol main.dropboxAppKey, the release matrix, tag trigger, workflow key source and permissions.
Update README installation commands, repository path guidance and current GRACE source/verification paths; do not rewrite archived plans/specifications.
An active C-EMBED-DROPBOX-APP-KEY copy matches its applied archive exactly except root statuses. Remove only those redundant active files after verifying equality and preserving the applied archive.
Do not change the git index, open the real user database, publish a release or push a tag. Execute sequentially and add no committed test files.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No OAuth/environment-source changes, domain/schema changes, new package manager or archive format changes.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: cmd/trainings-logger contains the existing command source files and cmd/cli no longer exists. GoReleaser main points to the new directory and binary is trainings-logger.
Generated binary archives contain trainings-logger (or .exe) and LICENSE without README.md or other README variants.
README launch instructions, AGENTS.md paths and durable GRACE context/graph/verification commands use the new command directory and binary name.

Build/vet and selected final GRACE validation pass; verify an actual local snapshot archive if a temporary GoReleaser can be obtained, with no publication or real database access. Archive completed work using the existing instruction.

Assumptions.Assumption: Archive means the downloadable binary release archive, not the repository README or historical GRACE archive. Retain LICENSE as the only additional packaged file.

The existing GoReleaser configuration is used by the workflow; changing its build main/binary config changes workflow artifacts. Prior sequential execution and completed-change archive authorization persist.
